title: AttentionLens
description:
Current attention bands over one relational problem-space state.

These vectors are views over shared region identities, not independent topic stores. The lens may guide access but cannot alter semantic identity, score truth, or admit evidence.

background_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in background activation.

primary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in primary activation.

secondary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in secondary activation.

tertiary_region_ids.description: Region identities currently in tertiary activation.
